# Simulation: Fields

The field medium is implemented in [src/physics/fields.js](../../../src/physics/fields.js). It supports vector/scalar sampling, gravity wells, walls, portals, diffusion/decay, and writes from world events and emergent subsystems.

- Create and resize field systems from world dimensions and parameters.
- Write scalar/vector field deltas and wall cells.
- Sample local force contributions and gravity-well forces.
- Resolve wall and portal interactions.
- Advance medium state once per solve according to runtime parameters.

The FIELD law name is a toggleable global contract; the field medium is stateful substrate. The distinction is recorded in the similar-concepts review.
